findings.title: Site served over plaintext HTTP
findings.description: The base URL uses http:// rather than https://.
findings.remediation: Serve the site exclusively over HTTPS and enable HSTS.

findings.title: Username enumeration via REST API
findings.description: The /wp-json/wp/v2/users endpoint returned 1 user(s), enabling username enumeration.
findings.remediation: Restrict the users REST endpoint for unauthenticated requests.

findings.title: Missing security headers: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy
findings.description: The following recommended HTTP security headers were not observed on http://wp.example.test: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy.
findings.remediation: Add the missing headers at the web server or application layer.

findings.title: XML-RPC interface enabled
findings.description: xmlrpc.php is enabled. It can be abused for brute-force amplification (system.multicall) and pingback SSRF/DDoS.
findings.remediation: Disable XML-RPC if unused, or restrict access.

findings.title: WordPress version disclosed via readme.html
findings.remediation: Remove or block public access to readme.html.
